description: Processing status of up to 100 videos in one call. Each item: {id, status, available_resolutions, pending_resolutions, encoding_resolutions, playable, conversion_percentage, estimated_time, ...}. No titles (use panda_get_video or panda_list_videos). IDs that don't exist or aren't yours come back in not_found. Returns {videos, not_found}.
name: panda_get_videos_status
title: Get Videos Status (batch)
